forces: Ordering evidence must remain byte-identical when Git creates a descendant merge commit after pull-request validation.

security_justification.audit_integrity: The change preserves immutable ancestry evidence used to decide whether a reviewed assessment preceded governed technical work.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: It changes no authentication or authorization path and accepts no caller-controlled identity or permission input.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The proposal baseline becomes an explicit author-owned commit reference rather than an implicit claim derived from mutable checkout state.
security_justification.concurrency: Generation remains synchronous and local; the only state transition addressed is Git history advancing through a merge commit.
security_justification.confidentiality: The implementation reads and emits repository commit identifiers and assessment metadata only, with no credential, payload, or user-data handling.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic primitive, key, digest, signature, or verification algorithm is added or changed.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The missing-baseline failure names only the required source field and does not reveal filesystem, secret, or repository contents.
security_justification.external_security_integration: The generator retains its local repository-only boundary and introduces no network service, identity provider, or external security integration.
security_justification.fail_posture: An omitted immutable baseline becomes a deterministic generation error instead of silently producing merge-dependent evidence.
security_justification.lifecycle: The behavior covers generation at later descendant commits and introduces no process, timer, shutdown, or background lifecycle.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Edits are limited to the assessment generator, its isolated fixture tests, one active generated assessment source/output pair, and this owning OpenSpec change.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No personal data is collected, transformed, retained, or disclosed; Git commit IDs remain project metadata.
security_justification.resource_retention: The change retains no new resource and performs no unbounded repository scan beyond existing generation behavior.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: The change neither implements delivery nor changes retry handling; it prevents a regenerated artifact from changing after a merge replay.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The source author explicitly supplies ordering evidence, while the generator validates deterministic structure without elevating checkout state into an approval boundary.
